import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem coordinate_images_and_local_rectangles {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X)
  (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst)
  (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  ∀ U : Set (X × Y), IsOpen U →
    IsOpen (π₁ '' U) ∧ IsOpen (π₂ '' U) ∧
      ∀ a b, (a, b) ∈ U →
        ∃ u v, IsOpen u ∧ IsOpen v ∧ a ∈ u ∧ b ∈ v ∧ u ×ˢ v ⊆ U := by
  intro U hU
  subst h₁ h₂
  refine ⟨isOpenMap_fst U hU, isOpenMap_snd U hU, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  have hU' : U ∈ 𝓝 (a, b) := hU.mem_nhds hab
  rw [nhds_prod_eq, Filter.mem_prod_iff] at hU'
  rcases hU' with ⟨u', hu', v', hv', huv⟩
  rcases mem_nhds_iff.mp hu' with ⟨u, hu_sub, hu_open, ha⟩
  rcases mem_nhds_iff.mp hv' with ⟨v, hv_sub, hv_open, hb⟩
  exact ⟨u, v, hu_open, hv_open, ha, hb, (Set.prod_mono hu_sub hv_sub).trans huv⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem coordinate_images_and_local_rectangles {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X)
  (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst)
  (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  ∀ U : Set (X × Y), IsOpen U →
    IsOpen (π₁ '' U) ∧ IsOpen (π₂ '' U) ∧
      ∀ a b, (a, b) ∈ U →
        ∃ u v, IsOpen u ∧ IsOpen v ∧ a ∈ u ∧ b ∈ v ∧ u ×ˢ v ⊆ U := by
  subst π₁
  subst π₂
  intro U hU
  have hfst : IsOpen (Prod.fst '' U) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hx
    rcases hx with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩
    rcases (mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (hU.mem_nhds hab)) with
      ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩
    apply mem_of_superset hu
    intro y hy
    refine ⟨(y, b), huv ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨hy, mem_of_mem_nhds hv⟩
  have hsnd : IsOpen (Prod.snd '' U) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro y hy
    rcases hy with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩
    rcases (mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (hU.mem_nhds hab)) with
      ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩
    apply mem_of_superset hv
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨(a, z), huv ?_, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨mem_of_mem_nhds hu, hz⟩
  refine ⟨hfst, hsnd, ?_⟩
  intro a b hab
  rcases (mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp (hU.mem_nhds hab)) with
    ⟨u, hu, v, hv, huv⟩
  rcases (mem_nhds_iff.mp hu) with ⟨u', hu'sub, hu'open, hau'⟩
  rcases (mem_nhds_iff.mp hv) with ⟨v', hv'sub, hv'open, hbv'⟩
  refine ⟨u', v', hu'open, hv'open, hau', hbv', ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  apply huv
  exact ⟨hu'sub hz.1, hv'sub hz.2⟩

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem coordinate_images_and_local_rectangles {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X)
  (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst)
  (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  ∀ U : Set (X × Y), IsOpen U →
    IsOpen (π₁ '' U) ∧ IsOpen (π₂ '' U) ∧
      ∀ a b, (a, b) ∈ U →
        ∃ u v, IsOpen u ∧ IsOpen v ∧ a ∈ u ∧ b ∈ v ∧ u ×ˢ v ⊆ U := by
  subst π₁
  subst π₂
  intro U hU
  have hrect :
      ∀ a b, (a, b) ∈ U →
        ∃ u v, IsOpen u ∧ IsOpen v ∧ a ∈ u ∧ b ∈ v ∧ u ×ˢ v ⊆ U := by
    intro a b hab
    have hmem : U ∈ 𝓝 (a, b) := hU.mem_nhds hab
    rw [mem_nhds_prod_iff] at hmem
    rcases hmem with ⟨s, hs, t, ht, hst⟩
    rcases mem_nhds_iff.mp hs with ⟨u, hus, hu, hau⟩
    rcases mem_nhds_iff.mp ht with ⟨v, hvs, hv, hbv⟩
    have huv : u ×ˢ v ⊆ U := by
      intro z hz
      exact hst ⟨hus hz.1, hvs hz.2⟩
    exact ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hau, hbv, huv⟩
  have hopen₁ : IsOpen (Prod.fst '' U) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro a ha
    rcases ha with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩
    rcases hrect a b hab with ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hau, hbv, huv⟩
    apply mem_of_superset (hu.mem_nhds hau)
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨(x, b), huv ⟨hx, hbv⟩, rfl⟩
  have hopen₂ : IsOpen (Prod.snd '' U) := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro b hb
    rcases hb with ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab, rfl⟩
    rcases hrect a b hab with ⟨u, v, hu, hv, hau, hbv, huv⟩
    apply mem_of_superset (hv.mem_nhds hbv)
    intro y hy
    exact ⟨(a, y), huv ⟨hau, hy⟩, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨hopen₁, hopen₂, hrect⟩
